I agree with these assessments. The 'floating' side elements are a critical structural failure—they have no logical attachment point, violating the physics of jewelry. The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed these because it only looks for noise/blur, not semantic/structural logic. The Topology Auditor's high confidence mask is misleading; it successfully segmented the 'blob' of the necklace but did not validate that the blob consists of distinct, physically valid links. The geometric depth auditor's stats are neutral, but the visual evidence of the side pieces 'sticking' to the skin without depth discontinuity supports the 'fusion' artifact claim.
